T3_q1_checks.check_1_note: n counts every logged causal evaluation of the poller and watch stores at a cutoff before some K1 record's availability ('Every evaluation at a cutoff before that availability keeps its answer'); each is re-evaluated with every K1 record available after its cutoff removed. n_reached_by_late_k1: those a late K1 record reaches (stamp <= dispatch)

check_2_sample.rule: all evaluations of contested decisions + Random(0).sample(sorted(rest), ceil(0.1 x len(rest))), per capture

b_targets_not_posable.83: no server span of recommendationservice in request 83's trace

clock_band.rule: theta = host wall clock - node clock; one reading (host send, node date, host receive) bounds theta to [send - node, receive - node]; b_c = 1 s (kubelet stamp resolution) + the widest offset bound, read as the largest |bound| over every usable reading of the capture (start and end), so that b_c covers the offset itself as well as its uncertainty; no correction is applied to any timestamp

cross_observer_agreement.semantics: never reconstruction: different observation streams; a disagreement is not a replay failure
cross_observer_agreement.store: two-clock (A1), stream S0, F = 30 s, as of each response receipt x_R <= H

design_check.rule: record timing only, before any label

thresholds.applied_by: design_check_verdict over the arm's included captures

labels.rule: labels never use R1-R7, a store or a view's knowledge rule

transitions.rule: counted objects = the changed service's Pods and the bound Deployment; stamps are the sources' own fields; a deletion request (deletionTimestamp - grace) earlier than the last record without deletionTimestamp by more than the clock band is inconsistent with the records and not counted (listed)
